qs.q: Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series? PQST, TOVS, ?, BKBQ, FIEP
qs.e:
1st letters: P, T, ?, B, F (+4) → X. 2nd: Q, O, ?, K, I (−2) → M.
3rd: S, V, ?, B, E (+3) → Y. 4th: T, S, ?, Q, P (−1) → R.
Answer: XMYR

qs.q: ‘E + B’ means ‘E is the husband of B’ ‘E – B’ means ‘E is the daughter of B’ ‘E $ B’ means ‘E is the father of B’ ‘E # B’ means ‘E is the mother of B’ If ‘N +D # Z $ B’, then how is N related to B?
o: N is the paternal grandfather of B
N is the mother-in-law of B
N is the paternal grandmother of B
N is the maternal grandmother of B
qs.e:
N + D: N is D's husband. D # Z: D is Z's mother. Z $ B: Z is B's father.
N is the husband of Z's mother, so N is Z's father.
Z is B's father, so N is B's father's father → paternal grandfather.
Answer: N is the paternal grandfather of B

qs.q: Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series. S _ U C T S R _ _ T _ R U E _ S R _ _ T
o: R U E S T V G
R V D S T U F
R U D S T U F
R V E S T U F
qs.e:
Groups of five: SRU?T, where the 4th letter goes C, D, E, F.
SRUCT SRUDT SRUET SRUFT → blanks R, U, D, S, T, U, F.
Answer: R U D S T U F

qs.q: Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? 11, 36, ?, 121, 185, 266
qs.e:
Differences are perfect squares: 5², 6², 7², 8², 9² = 25, 36, 49, 64, 81.
36 + 36 = 72; check 72 + 49 = 121, 121 + 64 = 185.
Answer: 72

qs.q: Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series. L _ _ RALMT _ _ _ _ TRALM_ R _
qs.e:
The repeating block is LMTRA (5 letters).
Writing it 4 times — LMTRA LMTRA LMTRA LMTRA — fills the blanks with M, T, R, A, L, M, T, A.
Answer: MTRALMTA

qs.q: In India Who among the following has the power to pardon, reprieve or commute the punishment of any criminal?
qs.e:
Under Article 72, the President can grant pardons, reprieves, respites or remissions, and can suspend, remit or commute sentences – including in court-martial and death sentence cases.
Governors have a narrower power under Article 161 and cannot pardon death sentences.
Answer: President

qs.q: Indian boxers ______________ won gold medals at the 73rd Strandja Memorial Boxing Tournament, held in Sofia, Bulgaria in February 2022.
o: Manju Rani (52 kg) and Nitu (48 kg)
Nikhat Zareen (52 kg) and Nitu (48 kg)
Nikhat Zareen (52 kg) and Pooja Rani (48 kg)
Manju Rani (52 kg) and Pooja Rani (48 kg)
qs.e:
At the 73rd Strandja Memorial in Sofia, Bulgaria (February 2022), Nikhat Zareen won gold in the 52 kg class and Nitu Ghanghas won gold in the 48 kg class.
Strandja is Europe's oldest international boxing tournament. Nikhat went on to win the World Championship in May 2022.
Answer: Nikhat Zareen (52 kg) and Nitu (48 kg)

qs.q: Which amendment of Indian Constitution removed the right to property from the list of fundamental rights?
qs.e:
The 44th Amendment Act, 1978 removed the right to property from the Fundamental Rights by deleting Articles 19(1)(f) and 31, and added Article 300A to make it a legal right.
It also undid many Emergency-era changes made by the 42nd Amendment.
Answer: 44th

qs.q: Where is the National Dope Testing Laboratory located?
qs.e:
The National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) is in New Delhi, at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium complex. It works under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
It is WADA-accredited and tests samples collected by NADA (the National Anti-Doping Agency).
Answer: New Delhi

qs.q: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. I have thus far sketched the events of my life, but I have not shown how much I have depended on books not only for pleasure and for the wisdom they bring to all who read, but also for that knowledge which comes to others through their eyes and their ears.
qs.e:
Wisdom = deep understanding and good judgement. E.g. Grandparents share wisdom from long experience.
Insight = deep, clear understanding - the synonym.
Clarity = clearness; folly = foolishness (antonym); emotion = feeling.
Answer: insight

qs.q: Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the underlined word. The weather forecast mentioned that there would be a cloud burst this afternoon.
qs.e:
Synonym: a cloudburst is a sudden, very heavy downpour of rain, so "rainstorm" is the closest meaning.
"sandstorm" involves wind and sand; "famine" is an extreme shortage of food; "snowfall" is snow, not rain.
Answer: rainstorm

qs.q: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Get up on the wrong side of the bed
o: Someone who is having a horrible day
Someone who is having a good day
Go to bed or go to sleep
qs.e:
'To get up on the wrong side of the bed' means to be in a bad mood all day for no clear reason.
Example: The boss snapped at everyone; he must have got up on the wrong side of the bed.
Ruining a plan, having a good day and going to sleep are different.
Answer: Someone who is having a horrible day

qs.q: Identify the option that can be substituted as the correct idiom for the underlined part of the given sentence. My cousin sister Neetu had an aerial view of the trade fair from the top of the giant wheel.
o: A bird in the gilded cage
qs.e:
A 'bird's-eye view' is a view from high above, an aerial view.
From the top of the giant wheel, Neetu had a bird's-eye view of the fair.
A bird in a gilded cage = someone rich but not free; birds of a feather = similar people; bird brain = a silly person.
Answer: Bird’s eye view
